clauses.sourceSentence: Creator hereby assigns to Brand all right, title and interest in and to the Content, and grants Brand a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Creator’s name, likeness, voice and biography in connection with the Content in any media now known or later developed.
Brand will pay the Fee within ninety (90) days after Brand's written acceptance of all Deliverables, and Brand may withhold acceptance in its sole discretion.

During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, Creator shall not create, publish or promote content for any company that Brand considers to be a competitor in the beauty, wellness or lifestyle categories.

Creator shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Brand and its affiliates, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to the Content or this Agreement, without limitation as to amount.

Brand may amend the Campaign Brief or any term of this Agreement at any time by sending notice to Creator, and Creator's continued performance after that notice constitutes acceptance of the amended terms.
Brand may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason, on seven (7) days' written notice, and in that event no portion of the Fee shall be owed for Deliverables not yet accepted.

If Creator engages in any conduct that, in Brand’s sole judgment, brings Creator or Brand into public disrepute — whether or not related to the Campaign — Brand may terminate this Agreement immediately and Creator shall repay all Fees previously received.
This Agreement will automatically renew for successive six (6) month terms unless Creator gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.
